verdict.rationale: The core Semgrep CLI/engine is hosted publicly on GitHub (semgrep/semgrep) and described as running fully locally, suggesting open-source availability of the core scanner, but a community comment explicitly notes that Semgrep Supply Chain 'is not open source' and requires uploading code to a hosted service, contradicting a blanket openness claim for the full product suite (Code/Secrets/Supply Chain/Platform).
